facts.text: Mei and MK were annoyed to discover that Bai Long Ma's group of rebels were not as equipped to save Ao Lie as the "real" rebellion.
Bai Long Ma explained that most members of his group were ex-university students who had gotten in trouble with Spider Queen's minions.
Bai Long Ma explained that the rebellion took the ex-university students in to keep them safe.
Bai Long Ma explained that his group was still made up of rebels but did not have as ready access to the same resources as the "real" rebellion.
Bai Long Ma went into another room and MK heard Bai talking with someone on what seemed to be a video call.
Bai Long Ma insisted that they needed to take advantage of the rebellion's resources to help two students find their friend.
Bai Long Ma admitted that he sabotaged a station.
Bai Long Ma admitted that his friend got arrested because the friend looked like Bai.
The person on the video call was annoyed that Bai sabotaged something without clearing it with rebel leadership first.
